target.statement: TABFAIRGDT achieves ROC AUC 0.906 ± 0.002 and Stat. Par. 0.078 ± 0.009 on the Adult dataset (vs. real data 0.926/0.178), i.e. the fairness-utility tradeoff cell for the smallest benchmark dataset.
target.dataset: Adult Census (45k samples, 4 num/8 cat features)

compute.basis: Method is CPU-only decision-tree autoregressive generation (paper reports ~1s generation for 10 feats/10k samples); cost is dominated by downloading Adult data, 3-fold pipeline, LightGBM downstream eval, and verifying the repo runs.

blockers: Repo may be incomplete/outdated relative to paper (only a GitHub link given, no configs verified)
Exact 3-fold splits and feature ordering must be reconstructed to match reported numbers
Baseline comparisons (TabularARGN, TabFairGAN, CuTS, PreFair) need GPU/deep models if full table is desired, but the single TABFAIRGDT cell does not
title: TABFAIRGDT: A Fast Fair Tabular Data Generator using Autoregressive Decision Trees
